import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); m=g>0
    lab,n=ndimage.label(m, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):

        sub=g[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]*(lab[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]==i)
        out.append((ys.min(),xs.min(),sub.tolist()))
    return out
